definitions.explanation: Action taken to stop something undesirable from happening, especially illness or accidents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予防|よぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手洗|てあら}い→手洗い：12761_tearai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Hand washing is important for disease prevention.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予防|よぼう}{接種|せっしゅ}→予防接種：11068_yobousesshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧{予防|よぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努|つと}める→努める：17701_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: To make efforts for fire prevention.

notes:
{予防|よぼう} means taking action beforehand to prevent something undesirable — most commonly disease, but also fire, crime, and accidents. It functions as both a noun and a suru verb.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{予防|よぼう}{接種|せっしゅ}→予防接種：11068_yobousesshu⟧: vaccination
- {予防|よぼう}⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧: preventive medicine
- {予防|よぼう}⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧: preventive measures
- {予防|よぼう}⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧: preventive injection
- ⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧{予防|よぼう}: fire prevention
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧{予防|よぼう}: crime prevention

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {予防|よぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prevent, to take preventive measures
- {予防|よぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努|つと}める→努める：17701_tsutomeru⟧: to make efforts at prevention

SIMILAR WORDS:
{予防|よぼう} (prevention — before a problem occurs) vs ⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ (treatment — after a problem occurs). The Japanese proverb {予防|よぼう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|まさ}る→勝る：11848_masaru⟧ (prevention is better than cure) captures this contrast.
